title: A small but growing number of founders are betting on bringing people together offline
summary: Founders like Brynn Putnam are building offline community-focused businesses with major acquisition potential, exemplified by Mirror's $500M sale to Lululemon. This signals growing investor interest in offline-first, community-driven startups.
content: Brynn Putnam and Tristan Walker have already done something that most founders only dream about: created companies so compelling that bigger outfits bought them. Putnam, a trained ballerina with a small chain of boutique studios, built the connected-fitness company Mirror and sold it to Lululemon for $500 million in cash less than three years later. […]

title: A24’s reputation is on the line with the SCP Foundation movie
summary: A24 is adapting V/H/S: SCP, a horror anthology set in the internet-originating SCP Foundation universe, following its success with Backrooms. The announcement has already sparked community backlash and threatens the studio's reputation.
content:
After the success of Backrooms, it looks like A24 is trying to cash in on yet another internet horror craze with a new installment in the V/H/S horror anthology series set in the SCP Foundation universe. But as soon as it was announced, the backlash started, and V/H/S: SCP already appears to be on shaky ground.
SCP is a creepypasta that, like Backrooms, originated on 4chan. The fictional SCP (Special Containment Procedures) Foundation documents, captures, and contains paranormal or supernatural anomalies. It's a sprawling story told primarily through wiki entries that mimic documentation you might file while working at a government agency.  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: A24的声誉因SCP Foundation电影而岌岌可危

title: The hidden monopoly behind your TI graphing calculator
summary: Texas Instruments has maintained a near-monopoly over graphing calculators since the early 2000s, with the same model dominating back-to-school purchases for decades. A Version History episode examines how TI established and sustained this market dominance through anticompetitive practices.
content:
The same calculator has been on most kids' back to school shopping list since the early 2000's and the dominance of Texas Instruments' calculator division goes back even farther. 
In the next episode of Version History, David Pierce is joined by The Verge's Nilay Patel and Victoria Song to tell the story of TI graphing calculators and how one company managed to take over the market and never let it go.


This is the second episode of the fifth season of Version History where we're heading back to school. We've already talked about the perilous journeys of The Oregon Trail  that many students experienced in the computer lab and over the cou …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 你的TI图形计算器背后的隐藏垄断
zh.summary: 自21世纪初以来，德州仪器公司对图形计算器保持了近乎垄断的地位，同一款型号在几十年间主导了返校购物。《版本历史》的一集探讨了TI如何通过反竞争行为建立和维持这种市场主导地位。

title: Humans, not rogue AI, are still the biggest cybersecurity risk to energy systems
summary: Human-caused cyberattacks remain the primary threat to US energy systems despite emerging concerns about rogue AI, with recent incidents and DHS warnings highlighting growing vulnerabilities from foreign actors. Traditional insider and external human threats continue to dwarf AI-related risks to critical infrastructure.
content:
Before recent high-profile hacks raised the specter of AI possibly "killing all humans," our energy systems were already disturbingly vulnerable to cyberattack - and the risk is growing. 
"We were always prey. We were just kind of surviving at the appetite of our predators," Joshua Corman, executive in residence for public safety and resilience at the Institute for Security and Technology (IST), told me last year. At the time, I was preoccupied with a Department of Homeland Security warning that Iranian actors and sympathizers could target the US with cyberattacks. 
Last week, I called Corman up to chat about recent incidents of rogue AI a …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 人类而非流氓AI仍是能源系统最大的网络安全风险
zh.summary: 尽管人们对流氓AI的担忧日益增加，但由人类造成的网络攻击仍然是美国能源系统的主要威胁，最近的事件和美国国土安全部的警告突显了来自外国行为者的日益增长的漏洞。传统的内部人员威胁和外部人类威胁继续远大于对关键基础设施的AI相关风险。

title: An undercover Google analyst infiltrated a notorious supply-chain hacking gang
summary: Google's threat intelligence team successfully embedded an undercover analyst within TeamPCP, a major supply-chain hacking organization, providing inside access to the group's operations. The infiltration represents a significant counterintelligence win against cyber-criminal infrastructure.
content: Google’s threat intelligence group said it had a mole inside TeamPCP's inner circle.

title: Don't call it an SUV: The Ferrari Purosangue review
summary: The Ferrari Purosangue prioritizes passenger comfort over cargo capacity, distinguishing it from traditional SUV design principles. Unlike previous Ferrari four-seaters, this model emphasizes human occupancy and luxury touring capabilities.
content: Unlike previous Ferrari four-seaters, this one is better for humans than cargo.

zh.title: 不要叫它SUV:法拉利Purosangue评测
zh.summary: 法拉利Purosangue优先考虑乘客舒适度而非货运能力,这将其与传统SUV设计原则区分开来。与之前的法拉利四座车不同,该车型强调人类乘坐和豪华旅游能力。

title: T. rex teeth indicate it ran as warm as an elephant
summary: Research analyzing isotope ratios in T. rex teeth suggests the dinosaurs maintained body temperatures as warm as modern elephants. This indicates T. rex actively managed their internal body heat rather than relying on passive regulation. The finding provides new physiological insight into how these apex predators functioned.
content: Isotope ratios provide a hint that the giants were actively managing temperatures.

zh.title: 霸王龙牙齿显示其体温与大象相当
zh.summary: 对霸王龙牙齿中同位素比率的研究表明，这些恐龙的体温与现代大象一样温暖。这表明霸王龙主动调节其体内热量，而不是依靠被动调节。这一发现对这些顶级掠食者的生理机能提供了新的见解。
